The build process consists of copying application files to appropriate system directories, removing Python bytecode cache directories, setting up a systemd user service, and installing documentation and licenses.

All dependencies are either standard system libraries or optional components that enhance functionality without introducing suspicious behavior. The operations performed during packaging are limited to file installation and minor service file customization using `sed`, which is a common and safe practice. There are no network requests during the build, no use of `eval`, `curl|bash`, or obfuscated commands, and no attempts to exfiltrate data or modify system files outside the package root.

The package adheres to typical AUR packaging standards and shows no signs of malicious code injection or supply chain compromise.
